cells.tense: You are being what you are, and the being is going on right now.
cells.ask: Say one thing you do well and why it works, out loud, with nothing downplayed.
cells.core:
You're not assembling a version of yourself to show people. What you are comes through as it is, and the room gets the real one. There's no gap between the doing and the one doing it, so your work carries your shape without you forcing it. The steadiness is there in a meeting, in a conversation, in what you make, whether or not anyone names it.

Most people spend their energy managing how they land. You've stopped doing that here, and what's left is you at full strength, arriving as yourself. It's worth seeing the mechanics underneath too — the pattern of why it works, the way your read on a situation gets to the useful part before the rest does. Knowing that shape lets you carry it into places you haven't walked into yet.
cells.sheetLine: You're not performing it. You're just being it, and it comes through.

cells.tense: You will have made it undeniable before the moment has asked you to.
cells.ask: Pick one thing today and do it with no announcement. No post, no mention, no case made for it.
cells.core:
When you let what you are show up and do the work at the size it actually is, the room takes it in without a pitch attached. Nobody has to be told what they're looking at, because the thing is simply there and it holds. That's the whole of it working right.

The bend runs the other way. You get ahead of each moment, making sure it lands before it has arrived, and the thing you are gets turned into a case for itself: see this, watch me be it. The shine you work to prove is the one nobody can stand under, and the effort covers what it meant to show. What's underneath is real. It doesn't need the volume. Let one thing land this week without your hand on it.
cells.sheetLine: You're proving what you are before anyone asked.

cells.tense: You were something, and you have been standing behind that door ever since.
cells.ask: Make one thing exactly the size you see it, not smaller for the room, and show it to one person. Then stop.
cells.core:
With this working, what you are gets expressed at full strength and nobody has to argue for it. You do the thing you do and it stands on its own. The people around you know what you're worth, and so do you, with neither side turning it into a performance.

The bend is that you describe it as smaller than it is. It comes out as a hobby, a phase, something to get to when you're ready, and the ready keeps sliding. The light didn't go out. You turned it down and called that being modest. What's needed is not another round of proof but direction: this, not that, and meaning it. Say what you want out of the next turn, then take the step.
cells.sheetLine: You've already arrived. You keep calling it not yet.

cells.tense: You are shining right now, and you talk about it as if it happened to someone else.
cells.ask: Name one thing that's here right now, before it's useful. One sentence, out loud, no framing.
cells.core:
With this working, you'd say the thing you do comes from you. People bring their questions and you meet them, and you'd put it plainly, without dressing it up or hiding it. The work and the credit sit in the same motion, right where they started.

The bend is that something else takes the credit: the project, the timing, the room. What you carry gets treated as what happened around you. Before any of it means anything, find what's arriving just now, the thing itself as it comes in, not the plan you have for it. Nobody's turn is coming around to you. You are where it enters.
cells.sheetLine: You're already the turning. You keep saying it's the room.

attempts.check: The unsupported claim is that the person is radiating and others feel it; the record gives the mechanism, not evidence anyone notices, so I keep it to what the shining does rather than who receives it. A reader could reasonably say the attention they bring is just good listening and memory, not a gift worth calling theirs. The asks survive being wrong: naming one reason out loud, writing where an idea came from, making one thing exactly as they see it, and naming what is here before it's useful are all useful even if my read of the mechanism is off. The sentence that serves me more than them is 'You are the light, not the ray,' which is the record's poetry dressed as theirs — it gets cut.
